column1: # §31.9 rule 2: the uncited claims of each contract file of the standard library and the runtime,
# as `with analyze <file> contract` counts them. Every file is at zero (D205: one citation per
# function, of the actual function's documented behavior): contract-view-tests refuses
# a file with an uncited claim. Not listed, with why: rt/wasm.w (25 fn items, no
# clauses; the view cannot compile it for the host), lib/contracts/sdl.w (needs the SDL headers).
